placements.why: Nothing in the (currently empty) strata covers instrument-calibration record-keeping, and this envelope's whole content — instrument name, frequency, and verification-against-reference-plates — is squarely organizational-record grain for an observatory. No existing strata name is even close enough for INSPIRED lineage; the content itself makes a standalone Calibration category legible, matching the canonical taxonomy this org uses elsewhere (Opportunity/Strategy/Product/Architecture/Organization/Proof/Templates/Calibration).
placements.title: Observatory instrument calibration as its own organizational category
placements.frame: What instrument, band, and reference standard establishes this calibration record as authoritative?

placements.title: Calibration claims are warranted by verification against a named reference standard, not by the speaker's say-so alone
placements.frame: Does this calibration record ground its claimed state in verification against a specific, named reference standard, or does it assert the state without that anchor?
placements.why: All three expressions state the same calibration fact but root it identically: verification against the June reference plates (src-1's performed act, src-2's instrument label, src-3's repeated verification citation). This is a subject future calibration envelopes will keep feeding — other instruments, other bands, other reference standards — not a one-time measurement; the specific numbers (88.4 MHz, June plates) are the evidence for this leaf, not leaves in themselves. No existing narrative leaf exists in this repo to hold it, so it is minted fresh under the newly-minted Calibration strata.
